messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve stock prices for.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

The function signature expects companies: string[] and duration: string. But we need to retrieve for each company separately? The user says "蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價". That could mean for each company, get prices for each duration? Or maybe they want to get for each company the price over those durations? The function only accepts one duration at a time. We might need to call the function multiple times: once per company per duration. But the user might want all four companies for each duration. The function signature only allows one duration. So we need to call it multiple times. But the user didn't specify how many calls. We can interpret that they want to get the stock prices for each company for each duration. So we need to call get_stock_prices for each combination. That would be 4 companies * 4 durations = 16 calls. But maybe they want to get the price for each company for each duration separately. The user says "蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價". The word "分別" indicates each company has its own duration? Actually "分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月" could mean Apple: 1 week, Microsoft: 2 weeks, Amazon: 3 weeks, Tesla: 1 month. That seems plausible. So we need to call get_stock_prices for each company with its respective duration. So 4 calls.

Thus we need to call get_stock_prices with companies: ["Apple"] duration: "1 week", then ["Microsoft"] "2 weeks", ["Amazon"] "3 weeks", ["Tesla"] "1 month".

We should do that. Then we need to output the results. The function returns any. We need to call it. Let's do that.
